template.description: UXDB（优炫数据库，PostgreSQL 兼容系）巡检模板。注意：UXDB 2.x 以 ux_catalog.ux_* 暴露 PG 风格系统视图，运行时参数通过 SHOW 获取，故 SQL 已针对 UXDB 实际目录改写

chapters.description: 版本 / 实例信息 / 启动时间

queries.query_sql: SELECT version()
SELECT instance_name, host_name, version, startup_time, status FROM sys.v$instance
queries.query_description_zh: 实例名 / 主机 / 版本 / 状态

queries.query_sql: SELECT startup_time FROM sys.v$instance

chapters.description: 连接分布 / 活跃会话

queries.query_sql: SELECT state, count(*) AS conn_count FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_activity GROUP BY state ORDER BY conn_count DESC
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, query FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_activity

chapters.description: 全部运行时参数 / 关键内存参数

queries.query_sql: SHOW ALL
SHOW shared_buffers

chapters.description: 库大小 / 写入器统计 / 库级统计

queries.query_sql: SELECT name AS db_name, total_size AS total_bytes, max_size AS max_bytes FROM sys.v$database
queries.query_description_zh: 数据库总体大小（来自 sys.v$database）

queries.query_sql: SELECT * FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_bgwriter
SELECT datname, numbackends, xact_commit, xact_rollback, blks_read, blks_hit, tup_returned, tup_fetched FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_database

chapters.description: 表体积 / 表统计 / 索引使用

queries.query_sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schemaname, c.relname, c.relpages*8192 AS total_bytes FROM ux_catalog.ux_class c JOIN ux_catalog.ux_namespace n ON c.relnamespace=n.oid WHERE c.relkind='r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('ux_catalog','information_schema','ux_toast','pg_toast','__ux_ivm__') ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_zh: 用户表体积 TOP50（relpages*8192 估算，块大小假设 8KB）
queries.query_description_en: Top 50 user tables by estimated size

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, last_vacuum, last_autovacuum FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_user_tables
queries.query_description_zh: 表存活/死元组与清理时间

queries.query_sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, indexrelname, idx_scan, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_user_indexes
SELECT locktype, database, relation, pid, mode, granted FROM ux_catalog.ux_locks
SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.query, l.locktype, l.mode FROM ux_catalog.ux_locks l JOIN ux_catalog.ux_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE NOT l.granted

chapters.description: 角色 / 密码策略 / 访问控制

queries.query_sql: SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb FROM ux_catalog.ux_authid ORDER BY rolname
SHOW password_encryption
SELECT * FROM ux_catalog.ux_hba_file_rules
SHOW wal_level
SHOW archive_mode
SELECT * FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_archiver
SELECT * FROM ux_catalog.ux_stat_replication
